trigger_rule: Whenever two or more dice rolled for damage from a Melee or Ranged Attack come up 6, you've inflicted a Critical Injury.
table_selection: If the attack was an Aimed Shot to the head, roll on the Head table. Otherwise roll on the Body table.
bonus_damage_rule: All Critical Injuries deal 5 Bonus Damage directly to the target's Hit Points. This Bonus Damage does NOT ablate armor and is NOT modified by hit location. It is inflicted regardless of whether any of the attack's damage got through SP.
reroll_rule: Roll 2d6 on the table until you get an injury the target isn't currently suffering.

body.name: Dismembered Arm
body.effect: The Dismembered Arm is gone. You drop any items in that dismembered arm's hand immediately. Base Death Save Penalty is increased by 1.

body.name: Dismembered Hand
body.effect: The Dismembered Hand is gone. You drop any items in the dismembered hand immediately. Base Death Save Penalty is increased by 1.

body.name: Collapsed Lung
body.effect: -2 to MOVE (minimum 1). Base Death Save Penalty is increased by 1.

body.name: Broken Ribs
body.effect: At the end of every Turn where you move further than 4m/yds on foot, you re-suffer this Critical Injury's Bonus Damage directly to your Hit Points.

body.name: Broken Arm
body.effect: The Broken Arm cannot be used. You drop any items in that arm's hand immediately.

body.name: Foreign Object
body.effect: At the end of every Turn where you move further than 4m/yds on foot, you re-suffer this Critical Injury's Bonus Damage directly to your Hit Points.
body.treatment: Quick Fix removes Injury Effect permanently

body.name: Torn Muscle
body.treatment: Quick Fix removes Injury Effect permanently

body.name: Spinal Injury
body.effect: Next Turn, you cannot take an Action, but you can still take a Move Action. Base Death Save Penalty is increased by 1.

body.name: Crushed Fingers
body.effect: -4 to all Actions involving that hand

body.name: Dismembered Leg
body.effect: The Dismembered Leg is gone. -6 to MOVE (minimum 1). You cannot dodge attacks. Base Death Save Penalty is increased by 1.

head.name: Lost Eye
head.effect: The Lost Eye is gone. -4 to Ranged Attacks & Perception Checks involving vision. Base Death Save Penalty is increased by 1.

head.name: Brain Injury
head.effect: -2 to all Actions. Base Death Save Penalty is increased by 1.

head.name: Damaged Eye
head.effect: -2 to Ranged Attacks & Perception Checks involving vision.

head.name: Concussion
head.treatment: Quick Fix removes Injury Effect permanently

head.name: Foreign Object
head.effect: At the end of every Turn where you move further than 4m/yds on foot, you re-suffer this Critical Injury's Bonus Damage directly to your Hit Points.
head.treatment: Quick Fix removes Injury Effect permanently

head.name: Whiplash
head.effect: Base Death Save Penalty is increased by 1.

head.name: Cracked Skull
head.effect: Aimed Shots to your head multiply the damage that gets through your SP by 3 instead of 2. Base Death Save Penalty is increased by 1.

head.name: Damaged Ear
head.effect: Whenever you move further than 4m/yds on foot in a Turn, you cannot take a Move Action on your next Turn. Additionally you take a -2 to Perception Checks involving hearing.

head.name: Crushed Windpipe
head.effect: You cannot speak. Base Death Save Penalty is increased by 1.

head.name: Lost Ear
head.effect: The Lost Ear is gone. Whenever you move further than 4m/yds on foot in a Turn, you cannot take a Move Action on your next Turn. Additionally you take a -4 to Perception Checks involving hearing. Base Death Save Penalty is increased by 1.
